//: N5: what the people of Quận 1 actually ask a stranger for. npcs/vanilla_off.json took dda's fourteen OPENER and ten ANY_NPC missions away in N1 - the American flag, the accounting record, the weather log, the Jabberwock, Zombie Mom - which left both pools empty, so every random NPC on the street had nothing to offer. These fill them.  D-fix (doc/saigon/DIFFICULTY.md, lever 6): each mission now pays.  dda pays a mission's value only with has_generic_rewards: the giver's 'Reward' answer (talk_function::mission_reward) adds the value, in cents, to op_of_u.owed and opens a trade, so it is credit against whatever the giver carries, priced at price_postapoc.  The mod prices that credit in gold, the traders' currency (npcs/factions.json): one chỉ (sgn_vang_chi, items/currency.json) is 40 USD = 4000.  Difficulty 1 pays half a chỉ (2000), difficulty 2 one chỉ (4000), difficulty 3 two chỉ (8000); the gold-shop mission pays the three chỉ its giver promises (12000).  Đồng notes are worth 0 after the collapse, so the value is never paid in them.

name.str: Muối bùi nước cho người sốt

description: Find <color_yellow>ten packets of oral rehydration salts</color> and bring them to whoever is nursing the sick.

dialogue.describe: You look like someone who knows what a packet of that powder is for.  Most people do not.
dialogue.offer: My neighbour has been burning with the fever since Tuesday.  She is four years old.  The clinic on the main street gave out ORS by the handful for a day and then stopped.  <color_yellow>Bring me ten of those packets</color> and I will get her through the night.
dialogue.accepted: Cảm ơn con.  She is in the back room, behind the altar.
dialogue.rejected: As you like.  I will manage.  Everyone manages.
dialogue.advice: A nhà thuốc will have them behind the counter if anyone is still minding it.  The bệnh viện had whole boxes, before people understood what they were for.
dialogue.inquire: The salts, con - ten of them.  Have you found them?
dialogue.success: Trời ơi.  You found them.  Give them to me now, and please do not touch her mouth, she is awake and she will fight you.
dialogue.success_lie: I can see from your face that you do not have them.
dialogue.failure: She went in the night.  You did not come.

name.str: Bún bò Huế cho tầng ba

description: Bring <color_yellow>three bowls of bún bò Huế</color> up to the neighbours sheltering on the third floor.

dialogue.describe: You have the look of someone who will come back.  Good.  I have something for a person like that.
dialogue.offer: There are six of us on the third floor of the chung cư and we have been up there since the night it started.  We did not come down because the stairs belonged to something with a helmet on it.  <color_yellow>Bring me three bowls of bún bò Huế</color> - there is a cart on the corner of Hai Bà Trưng, if it is still there.  I will pay in gold, and I am not joking about the gold.
dialogue.accepted: Go up the alley side, not the front.  Knock twice, not three times.
dialogue.rejected: Then go, if you are going.
dialogue.advice: The cart on the corner, Hai Bà Trưng.  Anything hot in a bowl, honestly.  They are not fussy, they are hungry.
dialogue.inquire: Three bowls, con.  And go up the alley side.
dialogue.success: You came back.  And you brought it hot.  Here - this is my mother's, she has been dead since the flood and she would have wanted it more than me.
dialogue.success_lie: You did not bring three bowls.  Do not lie to me today.
dialogue.failure: I should have known the stairs were not safe.  It is not your fault.  I do not know whose it is.

description: Find a family's <color_yellow>Red Cross first-aid handbook</color>, with the phone numbers written in its back pages, and bring it back.

dialogue.describe: Are you from this phường?  You have the accent.  Good, I need someone from here.
dialogue.offer: My mother kept one book, the Red Cross sổ tay sơ cứu the ward handed out, and she wrote every number she knew in the back pages - every number in Quận 1 and half of Quận 3, in her handwriting.  It was on the altar when we left and it is not there now.  <color_yellow>Find a first-aid handbook like hers</color> and I will tell you what names are in it that are not yet dead.
dialogue.accepted: The altar, con, behind the incense.  Somebody will have taken it for the paper.
dialogue.rejected: Sổ tay mà.  Fine.  I will wait until the phones come back on.
dialogue.advice: Cuốn sổ tay sơ cứu, the little Red Cross one, about the size of a prayer book.  The ward gave one to every household, and half the people in this phường kept theirs on a shelf next to the altar, not on it.
dialogue.inquire: The handbook, con.  Have you found it?
dialogue.success: That is the one.  Look - in the back, the same numbers she wrote in hers, the whole ward copied them from the loa phường.  There is my mother's number on the first page and she is dead.  But here, this one is the pharmacist on Hàm Nghi, he has not answered in two days.  Go and knock, and if he answers, tell him we are alive.
dialogue.success_lie: That is not a sổ tay sơ cứu.
dialogue.failure: Two days.  Two days and I have not even tried to go back.  I am the one who is late.

description: Recover <color_yellow>twenty chỉ of gold</color> from the shop before anyone else does.

dialogue.describe: You are standing in the doorway of a tiệm vàng with the gate still down.  Say something, or I will start shouting.
dialogue.offer: The gold is in the safe at the back of the shop.  The keys are on my father's belt and my father is upstairs.  <color_yellow>Bring me twenty chỉ of it</color> - one chỉ each for my sister and the two next door, and the rest to buy a boat out of Bến Nhà Rồng.  I will write you a receipt.  My father kept the receipts in a tin under the counter, and I have the tin, and there is no name written in it that is not my father's.
dialogue.accepted: The safe is behind the counter.  It is not a good safe.
dialogue.rejected: Then close the gate on your way out.  Please.  I cannot say that to many people.
dialogue.advice: It is gold, con.  So it is in every shop, every hẻm, every locket.  Anyone with a radio in their mouth will have found some by now.  You may have to take what they found.
dialogue.inquire: Twenty chỉ.  Have you been to the shop yet?
dialogue.success: You went in there.  Look at you.  Here - take three chỉ as well, you will need something soft to sleep on.
dialogue.failure: Someone got there first, or something did.  Either way I am not coming home tonight.

description: Recover the <color_yellow>ward notice</color> - the list of households under quarantine - and take it back.

dialogue.describe: You came from the ward office?  Then you saw what they did with it.
dialogue.offer: Every household in this phường with a fever inside is written on that notice, and the phường posts it at the loa every afternoon so people know who is not to be visited.  Somebody tore it down and carried it off, and now the công an cannot find it.  <color_yellow>Bring me the notice</color> and we can put it back up.  Without it people walk into the wrong houses and get hurt.
dialogue.accepted: It is a single sheet, folded in three.  Someone took it for the paper, or for the names.
dialogue.rejected: Then we will read it out from memory and get it wrong, and that is worse.
dialogue.advice: Someone took it who can read it and wants to know.  They have not posted it.  They are hiding it.  Look in the houses where the notice would not have been welcome.
dialogue.inquire: The notice, công an.  One sheet, folded in three.
dialogue.success: Good.  This is how we know who to send the men with the masks to.  Hold it up - someone tell them to bring the ladder.
dialogue.failure: By Friday it will be three days old and we will have carried out two funerals from the wrong house.  That is all.

description: Put down <color_yellow>six of the dead xe ôm drivers</color> still collecting fares along the main street.

dialogue.describe: You got down the street.  Then you have not been down the street at night.  Do not go at night.
dialogue.offer: The drivers are still out there.  Still on the bikes, still holding out a hand for the fare.  The worst of it is that when you get on, they take you somewhere.  You arrive somewhere.  It is not a place.  <color_yellow>Put down six of them</color> and the street belongs to people again.
dialogue.accepted: Helmet and all.  Do not take the helmet off - it is how they know you are one of them.
dialogue.rejected: Then stay off the main street.  Please.  Use the hẻm like everybody else does now.
dialogue.advice: They do not hear well, they hear the engine.  Walk up behind and do not let one start.  And do not pay a fare to anything.
dialogue.inquire: Six, con.  Count them, they do not always look like riders.
dialogue.success: Trời ơi, you look like a person again.  Here, take this - it was my father's, and he would rather it went to somebody who walks on the street than to a man who hides in an alley.
dialogue.success_lie: You are counting, but you are not counting right.
dialogue.failure: Then they will keep the street.  And we will keep out of it.  That is what the city has become.

description: Put down <color_yellow>ten of the dead market workers</color> who are still standing at their stalls.

dialogue.describe: You have been to the chợ.  Nobody should go to the chợ.  Say that again - you have been to the chợ?
dialogue.offer: The ones inside are the traders' own.  They open at four in the morning for forty years and they do not know how to stop.  <color_yellow>Put down ten of them</color> and the hall is a market again, and a market is the only thing on this street that has ever worked.  We would like our market back before the rice runs out.
dialogue.accepted: They stand where they always stood.  Behind the counter, not behind you.  Do not turn your back on a stall.
dialogue.rejected: Then the chợ stays theirs.  It is a very small loss.  People still need to eat.
dialogue.advice: They are slow and they are strong and they are standing in the cold store, which is the hottest place in the building.  Take water if you have it.
dialogue.inquire: Ten, con.  Then we can open the fish aisle.
dialogue.success: Tám giờ sáng and the chợ is a chợ again.  Take whatever you want from stall nine, it has been my stall for thirty years and I am done with it.
dialogue.success_lie: Ten.  You are not there yet.
dialogue.failure: Then we will eat elsewhere, or we will not eat.  Both are what happens.

description: Bring back a <color_yellow>prayer book</color> from the house on the corner where somebody died.

dialogue.describe: You look like you have been walking all day.  Sit.  Do not touch the bowl, that is for later.
dialogue.offer: My grandmother is in the house at the end of the hẻm, the one with the blue door.  She went on Tuesday.  Her prayer book was in her hand and I could not - there was something in the room, I could not go back for it.  <color_yellow>Bring me her prayer book</color>.  I know it sounds like nothing.  I know it does.
dialogue.accepted: Blue door, end of the hẻm.  She is the one with the radio on the windowsill, you will hear it before you see the door.
dialogue.rejected: No.  Of course not.  Everyone has their own grandmother.
dialogue.advice: Blue door.  And con - if you cannot get it, do not go in.  Come back and tell me you could not, that is all right.
dialogue.inquire: The prayer book, con.  Did you go to the blue door?
dialogue.success: Bà mất rồi.  The book is warm; it was in her hand.  I will put it back in her hands, with her rosary, when we can bury her.  And I will remember that you went in there.
dialogue.success_lie: That is not her book.  I would know the corner of it.
dialogue.failure: You did not go.  Thank you for not going, that is all.

description: Bring <color_yellow>ten stalks of ngải cứu (mugwort)</color> to the herbalist and raise your <color_yellow>survival</color> skill to 1.

start.//: the entrance tile of Thảo Cầm Viên (the ticket booth and the walk to the lake are on it), which is what the map marker should point at

dialogue.describe: You would look like a person who is not sleeping.  Sit down, then.  You want to learn to do this yourself.
dialogue.offer: Everyone comes to the thầy and the thầy is seventy and has nine people in the back room.  So you will do it instead.  <color_yellow>Bring me ten stalks of ngải cứu</color> - mugwort, lá thuốc, for the fevers and the bad stomachs - from the gardens, and while you are picking, learn to tell the leaf from its neighbour.  If you know which one is which you cannot poison somebody by accident.  That is the whole lesson.
dialogue.accepted: Not the ones with the white flower.  Those are the ones that will put you in the ground.
dialogue.rejected: Then go carefully and eat what you are sure about.  That is the thầy's advice too.
dialogue.advice: They grow where nobody is standing on them.  A park, an old garden, anywhere with a wall that has gone back to itself.
dialogue.inquire: Ten stalks of ngải cứu, and you have to be able to tell it from its neighbours.  Do not lie to me about the second part.
dialogue.success: Giỏi.  Now you know which is which.  That is worth more than anything I could have sold you, and I have sold a great deal.
dialogue.success_lie: You have ten stalks and you still cannot tell them apart.  Come back when you can.
dialogue.failure: You did not learn it.  Nobody learns it first time.  The thầy says so every single day.

description: Survive <color_yellow>seven days</color>, then come back to the person who sent you out.
//goal: B9-2: seven days from acceptance (the game started about 4.3 days after the cataclysm when this was written, so time_since('cataclysm') completed it in under three; D-fix moved the start to 8 hours after it, and acceptance still counts).

dialogue.describe: I will not insult you by pretending we know each other.  We do not.  But I am going to ask you something anyway.
dialogue.offer: I am one person and there are nine of us, and in a week I will be one person and there will be four.  I cannot decide who to keep.  So I am not deciding yet.  <color_yellow>Go out there, stay out there, and come back alive in seven days.</color>  If you do, I will put a motorbike helmet on you and follow you wherever you go.  If you do not, I will have lost nothing, and you will have been the one who did not come back.
dialogue.accepted: Seven days.  I will count them out loud every morning, which is my way of pretending it matters.
dialogue.rejected: Fair enough.  Most people say no, which tells me something.
dialogue.advice: Keep off the main street after dark.  Drink the water you boil and only the water you boil.  And do not stop moving at night - that is when they find you.
dialogue.inquire: Six more nights.  Or fewer.  Either way, you are still here.
dialogue.success: You came back.  Seven days.  I did not expect you and I am not going to pretend I did.  Get on - I know the hẻm routes.
dialogue.success_lie: You did not go out there.  But you are alive, and I have very little room left for pride.
dialogue.failure: You are talking to me.  So you did not fail.  Do not tell me it was hard.
